title: VITAdev experiment: NGS pool block splitting
purpose: Remove an extra vector resize that creates phantom pool blocks and can make valid NGS allocations impossible to free. This is the only emulator behavior change from the Plus baseline.
device_checks: Install over VITAdev and confirm that settings, saves and the imported Vulkan driver remain available.
Compare first with exp-plus-baseline-20261023 using the same driver, save, resolution, mapping and camera.
Check startup, repeated save/load, level transitions, dialogue, music and sound effects in Jak and Uncharted. Listen for missing or stuck voices.
Confirm that the sky, black rectangle, lighting and shadows match the baseline. This candidate does not change rendering or shader code.
Reinstall either APK over the other to compare. Both deliberately use version code 1030800.
